templates.name: Hospital operational housekeeping
templates.notice: Reduced operational housekeeping checklist selected from existing WPC checks, not an independently reviewed or certified compliance standard. Core safety and the facility's primary care/room checks are mandatory. Select every additional area/service present; omitted areas are outside this audit, not certified compliant. Existing wording and safety severity are unchanged. Use the full WPC baseline when a comprehensive audit is required.
